SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_year a, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(weeks_in_period AS VARCHAR) e, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) f FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period IN (4,5,6) 
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', CAST(store_key AS VARCHAR), CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), store_name, city, CAST(valid_from AS VARCHAR)||'..'||CAST(valid_to AS VARCHAR), CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR)||'/'||CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR) FROM dim_store WHERE city ILIKE '%Helsinki%' OR store_name ILIKE '%Pit%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', CAST(closure_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure

SELECT f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, sum(f.quantity) units, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, min(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l2, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) sk
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT 'rpt' k, sum(receipts) a, sum(units_sold) b, sum(net_sales_before_returns) c, sum(returns_net) d FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact_all', count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(quantity), sum(net_amount), NULL FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), sum(quantity_returned), sum(refund_net), NULL FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.sales_line_id
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT sku, sum(quantity) units_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) units_ex_staff, count(*) lines FROM s GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.sku, (SELECT max(product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku AND d.is_current) nm, (SELECT count(DISTINCT product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku) nnames, units_all, units_ex_staff, lines, coalesce(ret,0) ret
FROM a LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) ORDER BY units_all DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT p.sku, max(p.product_name) FILTER (WHERE p.is_current) AS product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE st.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.sku
LIMIT 3
